_readme: Full Tamil Nadu jurisdiction dataset: 38 districts, 388 blocks, 148 municipalities + 25 municipal corporations, 493 town panchayats (one duplicate entry in the source removed) (administrative tree); 39 Parliament Constituencies and 234 Assembly Constituencies (electoral tree). Sourced from Wikipedia's district-verified developmental-administrative-units, urban-local-bodies, nagar-panchayats, municipal-corporations, and Tamil-Nadu-Legislative-Assembly-constituencies articles (raw wikitext parsed directly, not AI-summarized, and cross-checked against each source's own stated totals) — still not the authoritative ECI/TN government dataset, and boundaries/names drift over time with local-body reorganizations; treat this as a strong, real starting point to replace with an official bulk import when one is available, per spec.md's Assumptions. Entries list a parent before any of its children — seed.ts imports them in file order.
